lines.trans: Do not overdo it, all the same.
No, but it is true, really!
Stop beating yourself up all the time.
I am the one doing badly.
But that is normal, it is human.
It is very painful being alone.
How long has it been for you?

examples.text: Ça va? Oui, ça va bien.
examples.trans: How are you? Yes, I'm fine.

examples.trans: You're also having lunch with Dany Boon.

examples.text: Il y a un macaron sur la table.
examples.trans: There's a macaron on the table.

meanings.note: elle a quarante ans = she is forty

meanings.en: il y a = there is / there are

meanings.note: before a noun: ce film, cette tête, ces gens
as a pronoun in c'est, ce n'est pas; becomes c' before a vowel

examples.text: Tu sais combien je voulais ce rôle?

examples.text: La plus grande imprésario de Paris.

meanings.en: trash, waste, rubbish; piece of trash (insult)

pronoun before the verb: j'en ai assez, je n'en peux plus
pour faire quoi? = to do what?
faire du vélo = to ride a bike, to cycle

meanings.en: to whip, beat up (se flageller = beat oneself up)

meanings.note: avoir honte de = to be ashamed of
before the verb: vous la connaissez? les voilà

examples.text: Je veux, mais je ne peux pas.
examples.trans: I want to, but I can't.

examples.text: Je ne veux pas te faire de mal.
examples.trans: I don't want to hurt you.

alone, in surprise or when you didn't hear; a bit blunt

examples.trans: Don't just stay there doing nothing!

before the verb; t' before a vowel

plural tous (pronounced 'tous' with s): merci à tous

examples.trans: She's too old for the part.
